question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4
solution:
The correct answer is **"Interventions".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• *'Representation to the Sports Minister and Chief Ministers and (4)___________by the politicians have all become part of the ' *In this sentence we need an appropriate word from the given options :
 
• **Let's see the meanings of the given words:**
 
 
• **interventions**:a situation in which someone becomes involved in a particular issue, problem etc in order to influence what happens
 
• **intersections**:the place where two or more roads, lines, etc. meet or cross each other.
 
• **interjections:**a word or phrase that is grammatically independent from the words around it, and mainly expresses feeling rather than meaning. 
 
• **intermissions:**a short period of time separating the parts of a film, play, etc.
 
 
 
• Here,politicians, are also involved as they are part of this, hence, the correct word from the above-given meanings is **'Interventions'.**
 
• The correct answer is **option 1.**

**Hence, the correct passage will be- ***Not a year passes without a controversy over the national sports awards. The debate that **arises **every year following the announcement of the **awards** often leads to accusations of bias, regionalism, and manipulations. **Representations** to the Sports Minister and Chief Ministers and **interventions **by the politicians have all become part of the (5)_____________. *
